name: UI tilt card
looks: An interface panel or screen is held at a fixed, shallow three-dimensional tilt over a near-black field with a soft shadow beneath it, its content sliding or swapping in place while the tilt itself stays steady. It gives flat interface content real depth without it reading as a plain screenshot.
build: Place a DOM panel inside a parent with CSS perspective and small rotateX/rotateY values, drifting a degree or two on the clock, with a blurred offset shadow tinted toward the field; for a true light sweep across the glass, render the interface to a texture on a three.js plane under a moving specular highlight instead.
sound: A soft slide or whoosh as it enters.
prompt: Hold any interface panel, product screen or document at a shallow, steady 3D tilt over a dark field with a soft shadow beneath it, letting its content slide or swap in place while the tilt itself never moves. Use it for any shot that needs to show a flat interface with real depth, keeping to one tilt per shot.
